mcp.description: Submit an OpenFold3 complex structure prediction; an independent backend that never satisfies an alphafold3 request.

limitations: Image sha256:3686e530...93b1de is the published, protocol-compatible -h100-r5 successor and runs as UID/GID 10001:10001; it remains candidate-unqualified until a live semantic H100 run completes through the public controller path.
OpenFold3 is an independent, non-equivalent backend to AlphaFold 3: distinct code, weights, license and results; it is never reported as AlphaFold 3.

The public scientific identity is openfold3-openbind so it cannot collide with the existing openfold3 HTTP catalog record; the legacy runtime-emitted openfold3 label is accepted only inside this adapter's output-validation boundary.

The exact OpenBind-0 checkpoint and components.bcif objects have immutable manifests and successful shared-filesystem localization receipts; route exposure still requires end-to-end scheduler, renderer, and semantic qualification.

mcp.description: Submit a Protenix v2 biomolecular complex structure prediction on the offline no-MSA lane.

limitations: Image sha256:b90a02bd...426af8 is the published, protocol-compatible -h100-r5 successor; it remains candidate-unqualified until a live semantic H100 run completes through the public controller path.
The v2 checkpoint was recovered from the immutable third-party mirror TMF001/protenix-v2-weights@653edab2 and is not yet byte-compared with the publisher CDN object.

The source payload 8e14bb80...12eca is transformed by localization manifest a093d28e...cc6b7 into the exact shared-filesystem runtime tree 5e1c3b54...74d48 with localization receipt ea301407...04b4; all identities remain distinct.
Only msa_mode none is admitted; precomputed MSA waits for a validated relocation contract and no mode contacts an MSA server.

mcp.description: Submit a deployment-authorized AlphaFold 3 structure prediction from a raw fold input.

limitations: Image sha256:ecc3e735...a85e7 is the published, production-protocol-compatible r7 successor; it remains unqualified until exact-digest H100 parameter-load and inference evidence, a raw-input run through the public path, and a live-qualified renderer exist.

The licensed parameter file remains tenant-private and is authorized once by the deployment; exact in-place PVC localization receipt 9c89f122...38bd4 is distinct from the deployment authorization document, and callers do not provide a per-request license receipt.
The public database tree d27b8956...dfaea has terminal localization receipt 3c7d4176...28874 on the reference-data plane; inference never mounts that public host root.
Raw-input preprocessing runs only in the 16 CPU, 64 GiB reference-data class; the live reference pool nodes are 8 vCPU / 32 GiB and cannot admit it until a larger reference class exists.
OpenFold3 is an independent operational alternative and never satisfies an alphafold3 request.
